transcript: even if you are unable to go to Edinburgh this year you can still experience some of the best musical scores of the fringe and all you need is a Spotify account as of today an EP released with three of the songs from Hot Mess the newest musical by Jack Godfrey and Ellie Coote that I absolutely adore go and listen to it immediately Orpheus the adaptation by wright and Grainger of the Orpheus and Eurydice myth also has an EP out that you can listen to with four of the songs so the Bengson's don't have a full album of Ohio however they do have a couple of the songs from Ohio featured on their Keep Going Songs album that you can listen to right now and there is a full studio cast album of Footballers Wives that is incredible one of the biggest surprising scores of this season all of these albums and more from past years are featured on my fringe playlist so I keep adding to this as we get new cast albums there's also some of my favourite scores from the fringe this year that we do not have any songs recorded from yet that I desperately need it especially Hole! and especially pop off Michelangelo that I've been waiting for over a year for something at least the title song and if there are any other scores that you really love from fringe this year drop them in the comments and I will keep an eye out for them
